There are always many people at the front desk. Last Sunday, Tom and Nina went to the training center. Tom usually has bread for breakfast. For example, she danced across the stage with astonishing lightness.
Nina is interested in drawing. Both of them like bread and juice. The training center is one of the best places in the city. For example, the live transmission of the match starts at noon.
Tom and Nina had great fun there. Tom hopes to visit Toronto one day. Tom bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. Best of all, she clocks in at half eight.
Tom learned a lot about science. It takes twenty minutes to get to the training center by bike. Tom is going to travel to Toronto in November.
